item.title: Akabanzu ~Real na Sekai de Boku ga Kimi ni Dekiru Koto~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Bonbon Company
  • 発売日: 2013-06-28
  • スコア: 6.65/10 (37 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あかばんず～リアルな世界で僕が君にできること～
  • 英語名: Akabanzu Real na Sekai de Boku ga Kimi ni Dekiru Koto

别名

  • Accbans

あらすじ

Kenta was a normal guy until he was introduced to the popular MMO Alpha. Since then, he’s been totally addicted to it, glued to the game except when he is sleeping (at school). The game basically took over every minute of his life. All his friends and classmates, and even his childhood friend, didn’t talk to him any more. However, this didn’t concern him as all he needed were his friends on Alpha, the ‘god players’, who are just as addicted as him.

item.title: Hin wa Bokura no Fuku no Kami ~Binbou no Kami-sama Datte Shiawase ni Naritai to Omotteiru no da~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Bonbon Company
  • 発売日: 2012-08-24
  • スコア: 6.85/10 (17 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 貧は僕らの福の神～貧乏の神さまだって幸せになりたいと思っているのだ～
  • 英語名: Hin wa Bokura no Fuku no Kami Binbou no Kami-sama Datte Shiawase ni Naritai to Omotteiru no da

あらすじ

A beautiful girl Yoshino transferred to Academy Touju, attracting the attention of many boys at the school. But rumours spread that any boy that gets near her will fall into financial misfortune and they began to distance themselves from her. Some kind girls offered a helping hand, but were struck extremely hard into poverty. Soon she found herself isolated.
